note: 생활 장면표(계획 Task 4, 2026-11-19) — 그 도시 사람들이 실제로 보내는 하루의 장면을 세 세계로 옮긴다(설계 3-1절). 장면은 그 도시에 실제로 있는 생활 모습만, 근거 src(위키백과). 장면 한 줄: key · ko · src · base(받침 · 장소 종류 · 자세 추천을 빌리는 일상컷 트리 장소 — data/casual-tree*.json) · indoor(날씨 줄 없음) · times · seasons(되는 시간대 · 계절 — 없으면 다) · outfits(이 장면에서 계획기가 고르는 의상 계열) · en(세계를 타지 않은 장면 이름 — 트리 장소 글, 지시문에는 안 나온다) · worlds.<세계>.en(같은 일상이 그 세계의 시대로 옮겨진 모습 — 일상컷 Place 줄) · props(소품 열쇠 — data/world-props.json, Around her 줄). 조립기(lib/prompt-city.js lifeTree)가 장면마다 트리 장소 <도시>_<장면> 을 만든다(받침은 base 것, 땅 = 도시). times 는 모든 도시가 같이, seasons · weather 는 도시마다(그 도시에 맞는 것만, 근거). 판타지 · 스팀펑크 글에는 그 세계 banned_en(data/city-design.json) 낱말이 없다(tests/prompt-city.cjs).

cyberpunk.en: a narrow, crowded youth-fashion lane two centuries on — tiny boutiques of smart-fabric dresses that shift their patterns, crepe stands, holographic signs and stickers floating overhead

scenes.en: a multi-floor game arcade of rhythm games and claw machines

fantasy.en: a hall of enchanted games in the capital — crystal claw cabinets full of plush beasts, rune drums that light up to the beat, tables of carved game pieces and warm lantern light

steampunk.en: a gaslit hall of clockwork amusements — brass claw cabinets of plush toys, coin-fed rhythm drums with spinning gears, fortune-telling automatons and penny games

cyberpunk.en: a multi-floor game arcade of the far future — immersive rhythm games of light, claw machines with drone grabbers, holographic fighters and a booth printing glittering photo stickers

scenes.en: a street of second-hand bookshops with stalls of books outside

fantasy.en: the street of old bookshops in the capital — tall shelves of leather-bound tomes and scrolls spilling out onto trestle stalls, a scribe's lamp in every window

steampunk.en: the street of second-hand bookshops — stacks of cloth-bound books and maps on trestle stalls under striped awnings, a brass magnifying glass on the counter and gas lamps in the windows

cyberpunk.en: the street of old paper bookshops kept two centuries on — real paper books stacked on trestle stalls under smart-glass awnings, a few holographic catalogues floating by the doors

scenes.en: a big water park with a wave pool and slides

fantasy.en: an enchanted water garden in the hills at the edge of the capital — a great wave pool stirred by water spirits, carved stone slides and cherry trees around the lagoon

steampunk.en: a great glass-domed bathing palace — a wave pool rolled by a brass paddle-wheel engine, polished wooden slides, striped bathing tents and lemonade at a brass bar

cyberpunk.en: a domed water park of the far future — a wave pool under a sky-dome of shifting light, clear tube slides looping overhead and floating lounge islands

scenes.en: a small sleeping capsule of a capsule hotel at night

fantasy.en: a sleeping alcove in a stacked inn of tiny chambers in the capital — a pale-wood niche just big enough to lie in, a thick quilt, a paper screen and a small glowing lantern

steampunk.en: a sleeping berth in a stacked inn of tiny cabins — a polished wooden berth just big enough to lie in, a brass reading lamp, a velvet curtain and a little shelf for her watch

cyberpunk.en: a sleeping capsule in a stacked capsule hotel of the far future — a sleek curved pod of white smart material, soft mood light, a ceiling screen and a sliding hatch

scenes.en: a packed subway car at rush hour under the city

fantasy.en: a packed rune-lit carriage of the deep tunnels beneath the island capital at rush hour — carved oak benches, brass hand-rings swaying overhead, travelers in cloaks and long robes pressed shoulder to shoulder, glowing tile mosaics sliding past the windows

steampunk.en: a packed wooden carriage of the underground steam railway at rush hour — rattan benches, leather hand-straps from a brass rail, etched-glass gas lamps, clerks with folded newspapers and ladies in feathered hats pressed shoulder to shoulder, white-tiled station walls sliding past

cyberpunk.en: a packed driverless maglev car deep under the towers at rush hour — a sleek curved cabin of smart glass, chrome grab rails, commuters lit by their wrist screens and light-lined tunnel walls streaking past

scenes.en: a cramped all-night corner store with a sandwich counter

fantasy.en: the cramped all-night corner provisions shop of the capital, lit warm by glowing glass orbs — shelves crammed to the ceiling with jars and loaves, a counter where the keeper builds a hot egg-and-cheese roll, a striped cloth awning over the door

steampunk.en: a cramped all-night corner grocer bright with gaslight — shelves of tins and jars to the ceiling, a marble counter where the grocer wraps a hot egg-and-cheese roll in waxed paper, a brass till and a striped awning over the door

cyberpunk.en: a cramped all-night corner store kept alive under the far-future towers — smart shelves crammed to the ceiling, a sandwich counter under a glowing hood, a drone hatch by the door and a checkout that reads her wrist

scenes.en: a picnic on the great open lawn of the city's central park, towers above the trees

fantasy.en: a picnic on the great meadow lawn of the walled forest garden — a woven rush mat on the grass, a basket of bread, cheese and apples, ancient elms all around and white-and-gold towers rising above the trees

steampunk.en: a picnic on the great open meadow of the central park — a canvas groundsheet on the grass, a wicker hamper and stoneware bottles of lemonade, elms in every direction and tall stone towers rising above the trees

cyberpunk.en: a picnic on the great open lawn of the central park two centuries on — a glowing mat on real grass, boxed lunches, real elms all around and towers of light rising far above the trees

scenes.en: sitting on the front stoop of a brownstone row house on a warm evening

fantasy.en: the tall carved-stone front steps of a red-sandstone row house in the capital on a warm evening — wrought-iron railings curled into vines, potted flowers on the steps, neighbours chatting from the next stoop and lantern light in the windows

steampunk.en: the tall stoop of a brownstone row house on a warm evening — curled cast-iron railings, potted geraniums on the steps, a gas lamp just lit at the curb and neighbours chatting from the next stoop

cyberpunk.en: the stoop of an old brownstone row house kept two centuries on between the towers — warm stone steps under a soft smart-light lamp, ivy on the railings and delivery drones drifting overhead

scenes.en: the iron fire stair outside an apartment window on a hot summer night

fantasy.en: the wrought-iron balcony stair clinging outside an upper window of a tall stone row house in the capital on a hot summer night — a pillow and a jug of cool water on the iron slats, potted herbs, open windows all down the street and the warm lights of the city below

steampunk.en: the cast-iron fire stair outside an upper window of a red-brick tenement on a hot summer night — a pillow and a jug of iced tea on the iron slats, potted herbs, open windows and washing lines across the street, gas lamps glowing below

cyberpunk.en: an old iron fire stair kept on a brick building among the far-future towers on a hot summer night — a cushion and a cold drink on the iron slats, a little humming fan and the glowing windows of the towers rising all around

scenes.en: the open deck of the harbour commuter ferry passing the great statue

fantasy.en: the open deck of a great harbour barge crossing to the island capital — salt wind in the sails, passengers at the rails and the colossal verdigris guardian with her torch of living flame passing close by

steampunk.en: the open deck of a paddle-wheel harbour ferry — white steam from its twin funnels, passengers at the brass rails and the copper-green colossus raising her torch close across the water

cyberpunk.en: the open deck of a silent hydrofoil harbour ferry two centuries on — glass rails, commuters at the edge, the old statue on her island close by and the beacon beam of her torch rising into the clouds

scenes.en: a crowded summer beach beside a wooden boardwalk and an old amusement park

fantasy.en: a crowded summer beach of golden sand by the sea gate of the capital — a long boardwalk of pale planks, striped silk pavilions, a great carved carousel and a wheel of lanterns turning above the fair

steampunk.en: a crowded summer beach beside the long wooden boardwalk — striped bathing tents, a great iron pleasure wheel and a carousel of painted horses turning in white steam, lemonade at a brass stand

cyberpunk.en: a crowded summer beach two centuries on — a boardwalk of warm smart planks, a towering wheel and a roller coaster traced in light and shade canopies floating overhead

scenes.en: a steaming street-food cart on a busy corner, a quick lunch from the cart

fantasy.en: a steaming food cart on a busy corner of the capital — spiced meat turning on a spit, yellow saffron rice, warm flatbread and a striped canopy, a line of hungry clerks and guards at noon

steampunk.en: a steaming food cart on a busy corner — sausages sizzling on a steam-heated griddle, warm pretzels hanging on pegs, a striped canopy and polished brass fittings, clerks lining up at noon

cyberpunk.en: a steaming street-food cart on a busy far-future corner — spiced rice and grilled meat under a glowing hood, a holographic menu floating over the canopy and a pay pad on the side

scenes.en: a narrow pizza-by-the-slice shop, a big thin slice folded in half

fantasy.en: a narrow bakehouse of the capital that sells pie by the slice — a roaring stone oven, great thin wheels of tomato-and-cheese flatbread pie on the counter and a wedge folded in half to eat standing

steampunk.en: a narrow slice shop with a black-and-white tiled floor — a big brick oven glowing, great thin tomato-and-cheese pies on a marble counter, a slice folded in half on brown paper and a brass bell over the door

cyberpunk.en: a narrow pizza-by-the-slice counter two centuries on — a glowing oven, great thin pies under a heat canopy, a slice folded in half on a glowing heat-plate and the night street of light beyond the window

scenes.en: a theatre dressing room before a show in the theatre district

fantasy.en: a dressing room under the stage of a grand playhouse of the capital before the show — a mirror ringed with glowing orbs, racks of jewelled costumes, masks on hooks and the murmur of the audience through the walls

steampunk.en: a dressing room backstage at a gaslit playhouse before the show — a mirror ringed with little gas lamps, racks of sequinned costumes and feathered headdresses, a call bell ringing down the corridor

cyberpunk.en: a dressing room backstage at a far-future theatre before the show — a mirror framed in soft smart light, racks of light-woven costumes and a holographic cue sheet floating by the door

scenes.en: a neighbourhood laundromat with rows of washers, waiting for the wash

fantasy.en: a neighbourhood washhouse of the capital — rows of great wooden tubs turned by water-spirit wheels, linen drying on lines overhead, warm lantern light and a bench to wait on

steampunk.en: a neighbourhood steam laundry — rows of brass-bound washing drums turning in soft white steam, a long folding table, linen on drying racks and a bench to wait on under a gas lamp

cyberpunk.en: a neighbourhood laundromat of the far future — rows of sleek glowing wash pods, a folding counter of smart glass, a drone sorting baskets and a bench to wait on

scenes.en: the New Year's Eve crowd in the great square counting down as a glittering ball descends

fantasy.en: the great square of the capital on the last night of the year — a packed crowd in winter cloaks counting down as a giant glittering crystal orb descends a tall pole, sparks of light bursting over everyone

steampunk.en: the great square on the last night of the year — a packed crowd in wool coats and top hats counting down as a glittering ball of cut glass and brass descends a tall flagpole, paper confetti and fireworks bursting overhead

cyberpunk.en: the great square two centuries on, on the last night of the year — a packed crowd counting down as a giant glittering orb of light descends between the towers, light-confetti and drone fireworks bursting overhead
